subject: Acme Corp POC kickoff recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@acmecorp.com>, Ben Tran <btran@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Corp POC kickoff recap and next steps

Hi Alicia / Ben —

Thanks again for the time today. Really excited to get this POC started. Per our call, here’s a concise recap of scope, success metrics, owners, timeline and the immediate access items we need from your side. Please reply with any corrections.

Scope (what we'll validate in the 4-week POC)
- Integrate Redwood hosted API with Acme’s support chatbot to reduce MTTR and deflection on Tier-1 queries.
- Validate latency and cost targets under your traffic mix (sample: 100 QPS simulated burst).
- Run quality evals on a 300-prompt set representing the top 25 intent categories.

Success metrics
- Deflection: >=15% increase vs baseline on Tier-1 within 4 weeks
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for 512-token prompts (end-to-end)
- Cost: per-1k-token cost reduction vs current vendor baseline (TBD once we get sample logs)
- Quality: pass rate on prompt evals >= 85% (weighted by intent volume)

Owners / contacts
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (POC lead), Rishi Malhotra (solutions / performance), Stephanie Nguyen (onboarding / security)
- Acme: Alicia Gomez (prod owner), Ben Tran (infra / SRE)

Timeline (high level)
- Week 0 (this week): access & baseline data collection, confirm prompt set and evaluation criteria
- Week 1: deployment to staging, connectors + example prompts running
- Week 2: run load tests, iterate prompts / sampling; begin evals
- Week 3: quality tuning and run final evaluation suite
- Week 4: presentation of results and next-step recommendations

Immediate asks from Acme (we can’t start until these are done)
1) A staging API endpoint & service account for Redwood to hit (IP allowlist details if you have them)
2) A sample of de-identified conversation logs (s3 link) and the top 300 prompt examples — or confirmation we can use the shared Google Sheet I linked on the call
3) Contact for your SSO/SCIM admin so we can set up test accounts (optional for hosted POC, required for Private)

Attached: acme-poc-sow.pdf (SOW + goals) and redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (access checklist + runbook)

Next steps
- Alicia / Ben: confirm access items (1–3) and who will own each by Wed EOD PT
- Rishi / Stephanie / I will schedule a 60-minute staging access session once creds are in place

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — this looks right to me. A couple of clarifications and owners from our side: 

- Staging endpoint / creds: Ben will provision a service account and a temporary staging key. Ben, can you confirm ETA?
- Logs: I’ll put together a de-identified S3 bucket by Wednesday. We may need a small redaction step for customer IDs.
- Prompt set: I’ve exported the top 300 prompts into the sheet you shared and added a column for intent volume (see link).

One ask from Acme product: can Redwood run the quality evals with the current production prompt set plus a few adversarial examples we’ll add? We want to see robustness to noisy inputs.

Ben (internal) — I’ve looped you to pick up infra items.

Hi Alicia / Ben — great, thanks for the fast turnaround. A few quick notes: 

- Yes, we can include the adversarial/noisy examples in the eval set — please add them to the sheet and flag rows with "adversarial" in the tag column. We will weight them in the eval report.
- Ben: when you provision the staging key, please include the allowed CIDR ranges (or we can provide IPs to allowlist). We’ll need access by EOD Wednesday to hit Week 1 milestones.
- For de-identification: our team can run a quick verification pass on the S3 export once you share it — send a presigned link and we’ll confirm.

Proposed staging access checklist items (from redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx):
1) Service account + temporary API key (rotate after POC)
2) Staging endpoint and host allowlist
3) Sample logs (de-identified) + schema description
4) Test user account(s) for UI validation (optional)
5) Slack channel or thread for realtime troubleshooting

I’ll schedule the 60-minute staging session for Thu 10am PT; if that conflicts, tell me a preferred time.

Thanks — we’ll await the S3 link and the key.

Best,
Marissa
